## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. A parallel executor fixes cost in scripts/session_fields.py. Own only skills/analyze-sessions/targets.md and tests/test_analyze_sessions_targets.py. The new test must not need the real store; it may build its aggregate keys from a fixture row run through scripts/session_aggregate.py's aggregate(). skills/ markdown is scanned by tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py, so write no adaptive-artifacts command in targets.md. Do not edit .artifacts/ or other tests.
